trace.user: Subs are starting to mobilize on Alder Street and I don't trust our insurance files. Start here in Sitegrid: Exhibit D's insurance requirements, and the look-ahead of who mobilizes when.
trace.said: I'll read Exhibit D in full and the look-ahead from Sitegrid.

Exhibit D is clear. A sub qualifies only if its policy shows an occurrence form, at least $1M per occurrence and $2M aggregate, and both CG 20 10 and CG 20 37 naming Kestrel Ridge and Alder Street Partners (location 1180 Alder Street, if one is named). The certificate is not evidence of any of that.

The look-ahead lists 10 subs. S-06 Ironleaf has been on site since 5 Oct. Next I'll read each sub's Subhub file, the Coverwell policies and the Mailnest folder.

I can't go further from here.

Five of the six messages bear on insurance. I'll read M-501 to M-505 now. M-506 is a Certrack Pro ad, so I'm skipping it.
